minimum_effect_rationale: prespecified practical log-score improvement; approximately 1 percent geometric likelihood gain, not a return-on-investment threshold
guardrail_rationale: fixed maximum acceptable degradation in each native metric; these are design tolerances, not established economics
development_gate: recompute full allqueue policy pairs; primary mean gain at least minimum effect; guardrail and coverage pass; hashed model card
independence_limit: one fixture per candidate/horizon; family adjustment includes every league/candidate/horizon; paired t inference still assumes sufficiently independent fixture differences
